verdict.summary: Round 3 remains correct and complete as a design-for-review record. The new evaluation is explicit about unread face-repository facts, requires verification at implementation time, avoids claiming circuit soundness or external audit, and correctly preserves the pinned-tag audit boundary: even additive abs/neg APIs require landing outside the audit snapshot unless the external auditor accepts the delta. Its acceptance criteria are non-vacuous, including signed-zero bit assertions, pinned NaN behavior, a mutation check, canonicality/forge rejection for any Field constructor, and unchanged instantiated-circuit snapshots. The companion correctness-program edit accurately routes directed rounding to the existing record and distinguishes abs as independent of round-and-pack sequencing. No hostile embedded instruction was detected.
